Simulate for 8.2 seconds and emit the trajectory (x stays at 0; motion is along y).
key_standards: The mass bounces around its equilibrium (sign changes in vertical velocity).
The oscillation amplitude decreases over time as the system loses energy.
The mass eventually comes to rest near equilibrium.
